title: Jamaican Spinach Bowl
description: A light and refreshing bowl filled with the flavors of Jamaica, featuring spinach, citrusy notes, and a hint of island spices.

ingredients.name: Canned Black Beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together quinoa, black beans, and jerk seasoning.
3. In a large skillet, heat avocado oil over medium heat. Add red onion and cook for 3-4 minutes.
4. Add chopped spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
5. Add cooked quinoa mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
6. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and top with diced mango, a squeeze of lime juice, and a sprinkle of salt.
7. Serve immediately, garnished with additional mango and lime wedges if desired.
